question: An engineer configures an Intersight Virtual Appliance and must claim over 200 targets. The engineer starts the Claim New Target Procedure. The engineer has prepared an initial comma-separated value file to provision the targets. Which information must be included in the comma-separated value file to provision the targets?
options: target type, hostname or IP address, user name, password
FQDN, AD name, IP address, email
theory: When bulk-claiming many targets into an Intersight Virtual Appliance, the CSV bulk-import file must supply, for each target, exactly the information Intersight needs to establish and authenticate a management connection to it: the target type (what kind of device it is), its hostname or IP address (how to reach it), and a username/password pair (how to authenticate). Fields like location, address/name, or certificates/email are not what the claim workflow consumes for API-based device registration, which is why the type/host/user/password tuple is required. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 13 — Cisco Intersight Virtual Appliance, Bulk Target Claim)
